headline: Chinese State TV Halts Real Madrid Broadcasts and Sponsorships
summary: Chinese public television suspended broadcasts of Real Madrid LaLiga matches and broke commercial sponsorships following remarks made by forward Kylian Mbappé regarding Mao Zedong.
why: Broadcasting and commercial rights in China represent significant overseas revenue for major European football clubs and European sports leagues.

impacts.name: Real Madrid
impacts.why: Broadcast cancellations and broken sponsorships in China impair commercial revenues.
